section.5: The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer

5.name_native: The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer

hadiths.text: Shu'ba reported:I asked Qatada about spitting, in the mosque. He said: I heard Anas b. Malik say: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: Spitting in the mosque is a sin, and its expiation is that it should be buried
